summary: Two residuals of the round-2 fix, both inside what the briefs sanction: (1) the hold in changed_since_approval applies only when an approval already exists, so a policy nobody has approved (or whose policy.approval.json was removed) gets its first approval, scopes included, from the next brief approve (verified: approval file deleted, core scope edited, brief approve records 'policy approval recorded too'); the human is not shown the scopes there. (2) A key with one live pattern and one misspelt one stands (as scenario 14 requires), so the misspelt pattern's paths are let go with only a warning. Blast radius: a first policy approval and partially-typo'd keys, neither exercised by a test beyond scenario 14's live+dead case.
